tool_args.rationale: The pilot is monotone and concave, and the acquired observations span substantially different sink gradients. Fit the archived gradient-dependent candidate laws numerically and select the best-fitting branch for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired branch probe already supplies two widely separated sink gradients; the seven rows permit fitting and comparing the relevant static mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.option: Siphon, cooperative Hill inhibition, and barrier-modulated siphon
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: None is excluded solely by the narrow pilot; the submitted fit compares their numerical residuals instead of assuming one in advance.

considered_alternatives.option: Sink-independent saturation and coupled memory ODE
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The gradient probe supports sink inhibition, while the observations do not exhibit a trajectory requiring a coupled memory model.
